author: Rjcmatt
quote:
Pros: Game is beautiful and the map is mid-boggling impressive. 

Cons: The main characters are wholly uninteresting. The dialogue is boring and the forced relationship is tedious and grating on the nerves.

The story is boring. It moved so slowly that I’ve pretty much given up on ever completing it. This wouldn’t be an issue if it weren’t for…

The massive open world is a chore to traverse. Traffic anyone? 

The devs broke from GTA tradition and put handcuffs on what you can do.

The AI is awful, it’s like we’ve gone back in time ten years.

In summary, I think multiplayer will be salvageable with patches and PC mods. The single player is atrocious and the writers or whoever was responsible for these characters and their story shouldn’t be welcome in good company.
